decisions.reason: As a related laser-marking line that has already been retained once and shows no visible sign of falling below aspirations, a large growing firm with slack would normally continue it.
Because this is a flagship laser-marking line closely tied to the firm's strategic Industry 4.0 direction and core capabilities, management would be very unlikely to withdraw it so soon after launch.
This new compact laser cabin fits the established portfolio and is likely to be given more time unless clear underperformance emerges, though it is less central than the flagship systems.
The lubricant printing system extends the firm's core marking competence and its trade-fair award suggests results at least near or above aspiration, so withdrawal is unlikely.
